verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents receipt capture only as manual upload through its mobile app, plus automated reminder emails to employees when receipts are missing. Both still require manual entry, so neither delivers automatic capture at the moment of card use. No evidence shows automatic expense coding or categorization; transaction webhooks are developer building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have receipts automatically captured and coded the moment a card is used, without manual entry
